human_authorization.record: Future freestanding implementation/execution authorization is not requested or granted by this proposal. The user CPA-003 request explicitly authorizes oracle/artifact preparation and hosted verification only; no governance activation or merge.

matched_control: Unmodified hosted make_interpreter_vm consuming existing tisc::decode output, empty pools/metadata, default explicit allow-all configuration and no CanonFS root. Independent mathematical oracle: exact integer arithmetic, sign-trit NOT/min/max/wrapped difference and manually reviewed control flow. No timing or efficiency comparison is proposed.
measurement_plan: Compare all 25 initial/post-step normalized records with all R0..R80 values/tags, flags, PC, SP, global halt state and all logical memory values/tags. Three fresh hosted processes observed 24 executed instructions, PC27/SP283 and zero differences. Future guest records require separate authorization, post-ExitBootServices evidence, the identical buffer, 64-instruction limit and 30-second deadline; retain raw records and classify every difference. No comparative performance inference.
method: Use frozen program.raw13: 351 bytes, 27 canonical opcode/u8 and signed-i32 LE operand records, SHA-256 b0649777cfa1c9e0fa1febb8bdfb1191c5cd3deea0d313791a4a32d5f207c80b. Independent Python integer/trit model and independent byte reader are retained in oracle.py, complete state trace in oracle-trace.json. Existing C++ decoder and encoder roundtrip the same bytes; unchanged make_interpreter_vm with explicit make_allow_all_engine, empty pools/metadata and no CanonFS root supplies fresh hosted observations. See freestanding-contract.json for exact system formulas and comparison projection. No freestanding evaluator was implemented. The proposed future experiment must explicitly accept this implementation profile or resolve the source/spec discrepancies first; see discrepancy-register.json. The oracle is not changed to make contradictory specifications agree.
research_question: Can unchanged canonical 13-byte TISC instruction bytes produce equal admitted computational state transitions in the existing hosted interpreter and a separately implemented bounded freestanding AArch64 evaluator?

security_requirements: Existing kernel security boundaries and governance activation remain unchanged
No host network, shared folders, FFI, model execution or persistent disks needed; serial capture only

uncertainty: Oracle and frozen artifact agree with three fresh hosted executions at pinned main. No guest evaluator exists or was executed here. Cross-profile agreement, negative trap paths, other platforms, performance and full Axion/CanonFS contracts remain unvalidated. Schema validation checks shape, not these scientific claims. Normative memory/control-flow prose conflicts with actual raw13 operand interpretation; mathematical agreement is limited to the pinned hosted profile. Human profile clarification/acceptance remains a prerequisite, not an implicit ISA change.
